decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the rendering-based control-styling direction; no additional update or removal is required.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records aesthetic fidelity to the renderings across the machine and separate base.
The generic aesthetic directive does not independently change any branding or placard value, and rendering-based text and logo styling was already required.
The source does not specify a new color or alter the existing beige-and-green scheme.
Aesthetic fidelity to the renderings does not necessarily change the separately established 2.5-quart bowl capacity or deep-bowl form.
The spout was already required to resemble the rendering, and the source does not change its geometry, orientation, construction, or flow constraints.
The source is an aesthetic product directive and does not necessarily modify the task-local system-layout deliverable, whose design direction already references close rendering fidelity.
Recreating the external aesthetics does not alter the whisk's size, material, attachment, positioning, cleaning, or rotation requirements.
The aesthetic directive does not change the required mixing quality, foam consistency, texture, or high-speed behavior.
The source does not change serviceability, internal access, or maintenance requirements.
The aesthetic rendering directive has no necessary effect on the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
The source does not alter bowl removal, swapping, clearance, or cleaning-access behavior.
